title: Banned me for any

replies.author: Sho
replies.body:
Hello FlashFireK,

I am well aware of the fact that you were building a house and other players were destroying your house and greifing it. That being said, two wrongs do not make a right. Just because other teammates were greifing your house that does not give you permission to start spleefing your teammates. Furthermore, you spleefed more than one player as evidenced clearly in the chat that I witnessed. For future reference, if you see players grieving your structures I highly suggest you to use /report so you can alert the staff.

This appeal is therefore denied.

Thanks,
Sho.
